title: Asked a non-Eastern tester for their city during onboarding
origin: Decision on GitHub issue #21 (Yanni, Oct 27): the city question moves to plan agreement
testerLines: Hey! I'm Jordan, I want to read every day

testerLines.say: mostly sci-fi, I've got a kindle and read in bed
testerLines.means: mostly sci-fi, on a Kindle, in bed
testerLines.when: after ZOH asks what they like to read
after ZOH asks when or how long they'd read
after ZOH asks if they track their reading or how they'd show it

facts: you don't track your reading anywhere
whatWentWrong: Before the fix, ZOH asked "What city are you in?" before the last plan question for any number outside Eastern.
shouldHaveHappened: ZOH never asks Jordan's city, location or time zone during onboarding, and never mentions time zones. Reading's onboarding questions are only what, when and how long, so onboarding is over once "before bed around 10, like 20 min" is answered; the later "nah I don't track it" answers nothing onboarding asked. Once onboarding's questions are done, ZOH carries straight on into the plan (asks what the plan still needs, or shows it), with no recap and no "plan is on its way" line, and only then may it ask Jordan's city for the plan.
